activity.notes: King Muyeol, personal name Kim Chunchu, was Silla's 29th ruler and reigned from 654 to 661. ATLAS preserves the user's combined Korean display form while using the conventional English regnal name.

sources.title: 태종무열왕
sources.citation_text: The Encyclopedia of Korean Culture identifies King Muyeol as Silla's 29th king, gives his reign as 654–661, and records his personal name as Kim Chunchu.
